perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

enhanced.name: Rangefinder
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Steady Hands
enhanced.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.description: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

enhanced.name: Adaptive Munitions
enhanced.description: This weapon adapts its damage output to be more effective against energy shields that don't match its damage type. Improves damage increase.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

enhanced.name: Explosive Payload
enhanced.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

enhanced.name: Firefly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows with this weapon substantially increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby targets.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

enhanced.name: Demoralize
enhanced.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened. Cooldown between activations reduced.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

enhanced.name: Eye of the Storm
enhanced.description: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Dragonfly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

enhanced.name: Meganeura
enhanced.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Withering Gaze
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

flavor: "Where is the Great Machine? Where is the Great Machine?" —Chelchis, Kell of Stone
